senses.gloss: योग m. 1. Junction, union, अन्योन्यशोभापरिवृद्धये वां योगस्तडित्तोयदयोरिवास्तु R.vi.65; 2. connection, contact, ततस्तदीयाधरयावयोगादुदेति बिंबारुणबिंब एषः Na.xxii.46; 3. a yoke; 4. a conveyance, a carriage; 5. application, use, means, नय इव पणबंधव्यक्तयोगैरुपायैः R.x.86, M.ix.10; 6. connection, consequence, स प्रीतियोगाद्विकसन्मुखश्रीः K.S.vii.55, Kir.v.52; 7. an annour; 8. propriety; 9. artifice, fraud, M.viii.165; 10. charm, spell, magic; 11. remedy, cure; 12. wealth, acquisition; 13. occupation, work; 14. association, mixture; 15. religious and abstract meditation, contemplation of the Supreme Spirit, (defined by Patanjali as (चित्तवृत्तिनिरोध) वार्धकेमुनिवृत्त्तीनां योगेनांते तनुत्वजाम् R.i.8; 16. the system of philosophy established by Patanjali, in which abstract meditation of the Supreme Being is inculcated as the only way to absolution and rules for its practice are laid down), यद्वेदाध्ययनं तथोपनिषदां सांख्यस्य योगस्य च ज्ञानम् M.M.i.; 17. an artificial astronomical division of time; 18. the principal star in a lunar mansion; 19. a spy; 20. a violator of truth; 21. etymological meaning of word (as op. to रूढि), e.g. योगाद् रूढिर्बलीयसी; 22. mutual connection of words, dependance of one word upon another; 23. a rule, a precept; 24. endeavour, zeal, इंद्रियाणां जये योगं समातिष्ठद्दिवानिशम् M.vii.44; 25. addition (in math.)
योग-अंग n. a means of attaining Yoga; (these are eight- यम, नियम, आसन, प्राणायाम, प्रत्याहार, धारणा, ध्यान and समाधि).
योग-आचार m. 1. the observance of Yoga; 2. a follower of that Buddhist sect which maintains the eternal existence of intelligence alone.
योग-आचार्य m. 1. a teacher of magic; 2. a teacher of the Yoga philosophy.
योग-आधमन, -आवापक n. a fraudulent pledge, M.viii.165.
योग-आधमन, -आवापक n. a fraudulent pledge, M.viii.165.
योग-आसन n. the posture fitted for profound and abstract meditation.
योग-इंद्र, -ईश, -ईश्वर m. 1. an adept in Yoga; 2. one who has obtained superhuman faculties; 3. an epithet of Śiva; 4. of Yājnyavalkya.
योग-इंद्र, -ईश, -ईश्वर m. 1. an adept in Yoga; 2. one who has obtained superhuman faculties; 3. an epithet of Śiva; 4. of Yājnyavalkya.
योग-इंद्र, -ईश, -ईश्वर m. 1. an adept in Yoga; 2. one who has obtained superhuman faculties; 3. an epithet of Śiva; 4. of Yājnyavalkya.
योग-क्षेम (I) m. 1. security of property, welfare, prosperity, मुग्धाया मे जनन्या योगक्षेमं वहस्व Mal.iv.; 2. the charge for securing property, insurance; 3. property, gain.

योग-क्षेम (II) m. or n. du. (or n. sing.) gain and security, maintenance of the old and acquisition of the new, (अलभ्यलाभो योगः । लब्धपरिपालनं क्षेमः Vijnyāneśvara on Yaj.i.100), तेषां नित्याभियुक्तानां योगक्षेमं वहाम्यहम् Bg.ix.22.
योग-चूर्ण m.n. magical powder, फणिमुखकाकलीसंदंशकपुरुषशीर्षकयोगचूर्णयोगवर्तिकाप्रभृत्यनेकोपकरणयुक्तः D.K.
योग-तारका, -तारा f. the chief star in a constellation.
योग-तारका, -तारा f. the chief star in a constellation.
योग-दान n. 1. communicating the Yoga doctrine; 2. a fraudulent gift.
योग-धारणा f. perseverance in devotion.
योग-नाथ, -पति m. an epithet of Śiva or Viṣṇu.
योग-नाथ, -पति m. an epithet of Śiva or Viṣṇu.
योग-निद्रा f. 1. a state of half contemplation and half sleep; 2. the sleep of Viṣṇu at the end of the world, R.x.14.
योग-पट्ट n. a cloth thrown over the back and knees of an ascetic during meditation.
योग-बल n. 1. supernatural power, the power of devotion; 2. power of magic.
योग-माया f. 1. the personified power of God in the creation of the world; 2. a name of the goddess Durgā.
योग-रंग m. the orange.

योग-रूढ m. a word which retains only a part of its etymological meaning; (the word पंकज, for instance, may etymologically mean ‘anything produced in mud,’ but its meanings are restricted to only some of the thing so produced).
योग-रोचना f. a magical ointment having the power of making one invisible or invulnerable, तेन च परितुष्टेन योगरोचना मे दत्ता Mrich.iii.
योग-वर्तिका f. a magical lamp, a magical lantern.
योग-वाहिन् m.n. a medium for mixing medicines (such as honey).
योग-वाही f. 1. an alkali; 2. quick-silver.
योग-विक्रय m. a fraudulent sale.
योग-विद् m. 1. an epithet of Śiva; 2. a follower or practiser of Yoga; 3. a magician; 4. a compounder of medicines.
योग-विभाग m. 1. separation of that which is usually combined; 2. the separation of the words of a sūtra or text.
योग-समाधि m. the absorption of the soul in profound meditation, तमसः परमापदव्ययं पुरुषं योगसमाधिना R.viii.24.
योग-सार m. a universal remedy, a panacea.
योगिन् m. 1. A follower of the Yoga philosophy; 2. a devotee, an ascetic, योगी युंजीत सततमात्मानं रहसि स्थितः Bg.vi.10, R.vi.38; 3. a magician.
योगिनी f. 1. A devotee; 2. fairy, a witch; 3. name of eight female attendants on Durgā.
योगेष्ट n. Lead.
योग्य (I) a. (f. ग्या) 1. Useful, fit, appropriate, R.vi.29; 2. fit for, capable of; 3. fit for Yoga or religious meditation.
योग्य (II) m. A calculator of expedients.
योग्य (III) n. 1. A carriage, a vehicle; 2. cake; 3. sandal-wood.
योग्य (I) a. (f. ग्या) 1. Useful, fit, appropriate, R.vi.29; 2. fit for, capable of; 3. fit for Yoga or religious meditation.
योग्या f. Exercise, practice, सूच्यतेऽस्य धनुर्योग्या प्रकोष्ठकिणमालया B.R.iii.1, R.viii.19.

योग्य-ता f. 1. propriety, appropriateness; (in Nyāya philosophy योग्यता is defined as the capability of a word to be used in a certain sense in a certain context); 2. ability, capability, धारणासु योग्यता मनसः Yoga.S.ii.53.
